subject.title: Feature: Inter-session progress streaming for sessions_send (ACP/long-running session support)

question: Should OpenClaw solve this by adding a `sessions_send` progress option, a separate `sessions_subscribe`/gateway run-events API, or by making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826 the canonical structured process-events surface?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent API shape decides cross-session authorization, event retention, replay semantics, redaction, and what sensitive tool/assistant data can be shown to another session.

options.title: Unify With Structured Process Events
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826 as the canonical event model and make `sessions_send` caller-visible progress consume that surface.

options.title: Add Narrow Session Subscription
options.body: Introduce a bounded `sessions_subscribe` or gateway run-events API now, with explicit permission and retention rules.

options.title: Document Final-Only Behavior
options.body: Keep `sessions_send` as accepted/final-announce only and document polling/final-summary expectations instead of exposing progress streaming.

recommendation.title: Unify With Structured Process Events
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/52826 as the canonical event model and make `sessions_send` caller-visible progress consume that surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches core Gateway/session API direction, and steipete has recent history across the sessions/A2A and run-wait surfaces.
